vitestro_role: Ground truth for rapid hemodynamic change
evidence_summary: Joint BP/R-R models and BP-only deep learning predict tilt-induced syncope, but wearable cuffless systems have not reliably tracked the rapid presyncopal BP fall
main_failure_mode: No reviewed wrist device provides validated fast continuous BP for this use case

vitestro_role: Cardiac timing, rhythm, HR trend, and ECG-derived HRV
evidence_summary: ECG-derived R-R adds mechanistic and modeling value; HRV alone is not sufficiently discriminative
main_failure_mode: Chest adhesion, motion artifact, and false equivalence between ECG HRV and PPG PRV

vitestro_role: Pulse waveform morphology, pulse-rate trend, PRV, perfusion proxies, and signal quality
evidence_summary: A Galaxy Watch raw-PPG model showed direct prospective HUT prediction evidence
main_failure_mode: Controlled HUT evidence may not generalize to venipuncture; motion, low perfusion, fit, and pigmentation affect quality

vitestro_role: Sweating/arousal signal and potential early warning
evidence_summary: EDA increased before syncope in 62% of syncopal HUT patients and often preceded measured hemodynamic change
main_failure_mode: Absent in 25% and strongly confounded by anxiety, pain, thermoregulation, and sensor location

vitestro_role: Peripheral vasomotor context and optical-signal interpretation
evidence_summary: Peripheral or facial temperature changes may contain anticipatory information
main_failure_mode: Ambient conditions, attachment site, and slow thermal dynamics limit acute specificity

evidence_summary: Respiratory change can help distinguish discomfort or anxiety from hemodynamic collapse
main_failure_mode: Many devices expose only derived or rest-gated respiratory rate rather than a raw waveform

vitestro_role: Late hypoxemia check and optical-quality context
evidence_summary: Useful as a reference safety channel when clinically indicated
main_failure_mode: Usually intermittent or algorithmically smoothed and is not an established early VVR detector

vitestro_role: Artifact rejection, procedural staging, and recovery/posture annotation
evidence_summary: Procedure phase and movement are necessary to interpret wearable physiology
main_failure_mode: Unlogged movement can create false changes that resemble acute physiology

vitestro_role: Separate presyncope from pain, anxiety, nausea, and general discomfort
evidence_summary: Prodromes have an ordered time course; standardized donor-reaction instruments and ISBT categories improve labeling
main_failure_mode: Self-report can be delayed or absent and must not be treated as a perfect reference

vitestro_role: Calibrate prior probability before acute sensing
evidence_summary: Age, first donation, blood volume, BP, fear, anxiety, prior reaction, and procedure context recur across donor studies
main_failure_mode: Baseline risk factors do not detect an acute event and can encode population bias

vitestro_role: Pre-procedure risk signal and observable pain/anxiety context
evidence_summary: Facial-action and short-video models have shown direct blood-donation VVR classification signals
main_failure_mode: Lighting, pose, occlusion, privacy, demographic robustness, and limited external validation

evidence_summary: A 193-donor study reported sensitivity 0.87, specificity 0.84, F1 0.86, and PR-AUC 0.93
main_failure_mode: Specialized camera, ambient-temperature control, small test set, and no external Vitestro validation
